newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong stocks seen opening up in range trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks seen opening up in range trading.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to open higher on Friday following Wall Street's gain overnight but trading is likely to keep within a 150-point range on lack of impetus, brokers said.
"Blue chips are seen sluggish but tending to edge higher on the back of Wall Street and the strong U.S. dollar," said Andrew To, dealing director at OSK Asia Securities.

Peter Lui, institutional sales at NAVA SC Securities, said trading should move sideway on concerns about the Hong Kong dollar which has come under pressure lately. Tight liquidity had pushed the interbank rate for one-month to above seven percent.
